achievements.title: Majestic Revelations
achievements.description: Unlock every other achievement.

achievements.title: Rescue the Lady
achievements.description: Stop the NSF terrorists on Liberty Island.

achievements.title: On the Town
achievements.description: Free the hostages, discover the NSF generator, and take down the NSF's EMP field.

achievements.title: The Lebedev Sanction
achievements.description: Locate the airfield where the NSF moved the Ambrosia, and hear some shocking details from Paul.

achievements.title: Inevitable Choices
achievements.description: Question your alliances.

achievements.title: Breakout
achievements.description: Escape the Majestic 12 facility.

achievements.title: Hong Kong
achievements.description: Find Tracer Tong, obtain the ROM encoding for the Dragon's Tooth, and ally the Triads.

achievements.title: The Supertanker Part 1
achievements.description: Meet Stanton Dowd and discuss the supertanker.

achievements.title: The Supertanker Part 2
achievements.description: Scuttle the supertanker and disable the EM disruption field before escaping the shipyard.

achievements.title: Grey Paree
achievements.description: Meet with Nicolette DuClare and make contact with the Illuminati.

achievements.title: Treasures of the Templars
achievements.description: Access the computer so that Morgan Everett can complete his work on the Gray Death cure.

achievements.title: Vandenberg AFB
achievements.description: Uplink Daedalus and gain Morgan Everett access to the Universal Constructor.

achievements.title: By the Sea
achievements.description: Steal a submarine and retrieve the schematic for the Universal Constructor.

achievements.title: Area 51
achievements.description: Decide the fate of mankind.

achievements.title: Second Coming
achievements.description: Complete the game by merging with Helios.

achievements.title: Cut the Cord
achievements.description: Complete the game by enacting a new Dark Age.

achievements.title: Shaking the Invisible Hand
achievements.description: Complete the game by joining the Illuminati.

achievements.title: Biomachina
achievements.description: Install at least one augmentation into each body part.

achievements.title: Slugger
achievements.description: Take down 3 enemies with a melee attack while the Combat Strength augmentation is active.

achievements.title: Solid Sneak
achievements.description: Sneak past 3 enemies with the Run Silent augmentation active.

achievements.title: Section 9 Methods
achievements.description: Travel through a humanoid enemy's line of sight while the Cloak augmentation is active.

achievements.title: Automotonophobia
achievements.description: Travel through the line of sight of a machine with the Radar Transparency augmentation active.

achievements.title: Wardenclyffe Man
achievements.description: Activate 3 other augmentations while the Power Recirculator augmentation is active.

achievements.title: Atom Heart Son
achievements.description: Increase the level of 3 other augmentations by using the Synthetic Heart augmentation.

achievements.title: The Best Offense Is...
achievements.description: Kill an enemy with their own projectile via the Aggressive Defense System.

achievements.title: Special Eyes
achievements.description: Alert an enemy seen through a surface with the Vision Enhancement augmentation active.

achievements.title: Public Servant
achievements.description: Grant the sick bum's request in Battery Park.

achievements.title: JC Dunkin'
achievements.description: Score a basket in Hell's Kitchen.

achievements.title: El Escapa
achievements.description: Successfully break Miguel out of the MJ12 detention facility.

achievements.title: You Saw Nothing
achievements.description: Listen to Walton Simons' interrogation of the NSF soldiers.

achievements.title: I'm In
achievements.description: Enter the secret compartment in Alex Jacobson's office.

achievements.title: Pinball Wizard
achievements.description: Reveal the secret room in the NSF Helibase.

achievements.title: Don't Feed the Wildlife
achievements.description: Feed a body to a Karkian or Greasel.

achievements.title: Dibbuk Defusal
achievements.description: Something's odd about that odd mechanic. Maybe Everett would know about him.

achievements.title: Sure
achievements.description: Pay Mercedes and Tessa's entry fee.

achievements.title: Renton, Far From Home
achievements.description: Save Sandra from JoJo, mourn Mr. Renton's untimely death, and meet Sandra in California.

achievements.title: American Hero
achievements.description: Despite everything, keep your allies and friends alive.

achievements.title: Lose the Tail
achievements.description: If you mention Stanton Dowd to Joe Greene... watch your back.

achievements.title: No Thanks, Mean Joe
achievements.description: Ah, yes. A journalist. You can trust him...

achievements.title: Based
achievements.description: Talk with Leo Gold further after detaining him.

achievements.title: Nice Gun, Mind If I Have It?
achievements.description: Obtain an assault rifle on your first mission on Liberty Island.

achievements.title: Nerves of Steel
achievements.description: Stop Anna Navarre from killing Lebedev.

achievements.title: Thanks a 'Ton, JC
achievements.description: Don't be afraid, I'm with you, Paul.

achievements.title: How Did You...
achievements.description: Two passwords for your life.

achievements.title: I Am Not a Machi...
achievements.description: Having a man on the inside at UNATCO pays off.

achievements.title: What a Shame
achievements.description: Comment on Mr. Renton's untimely passing.

achievements.title: Pool Shark
achievements.description: Use the cue ball to sink all other balls on the Underworld's pool table.

achievements.title: Veteran Agent
achievements.description: Have two Master level skills at the same time.

achievements.title: Lock and Load
achievements.description: Install one of each compatible upgrade type onto a single weapon.

achievements.title: Upgrades, people. Upgrades
achievements.description: Fully upgrade an augmentation.
